summary: Design retention, deletion, and cloud records controls aligned with ISO 15489 and ISO 16175. Explore the five-day course and request details.
lede: Digital records management helps records managers and governance teams control how cloud collaboration content is classified, retained, and disposed of. This training is for records, legal and compliance professionals and platform administrators who need to turn policy into practical controls, including mapping information types, developing retention and disposal schedules, and reviewing legal-hold workflows for email, chat, shared documents, and AI-generated content using ISO 15489 and ISO 16175 concepts.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who set information lifecycle rules or translate them into controls across cloud collaboration and enterprise content management environments.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with records, information governance, legal or compliance work, or administration of collaboration platforms is recommended. No programming is required. Bring a laptop for working with course templates; access to a live Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, or ECM tenant is not assumed.
